title: Speech to Text with Scribe: Transcribe Any Audio in ElevenLabs
desc:
Scribe is the ElevenLabs speech to text model. This episode covers Scribe v2, Scribe v2 Realtime and Scribe v2 Medical, how to transcribe a file in the dashboard, what the API returns, keyterm prompting, no verbatim mode, entity detection and transcript editing, file limits and formats, accuracy by language, and the Transcript Editor with its export formats.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
